summary: T7-03 round 7 at b073629: all five story checks exit 0. The layout, banners, header, footer and page-check changes match the acceptance criteria as far as I could read them. The gzip -9 initial-JS figure was not reproduced because the shell rules forbid loops and pipes. The tests were read only partly.

The gzip -9 sum of the initial scripts needs a shell loop or pipe, which the review rules forbid. The author's figure is 177,190 B against the 250 kB budget, but I did not reproduce it.
All 15 changed paths are in the story's files list or under apps/web/tests/*. Working tree is clean.

findings.claim: AC2 says 'Bundle <bundle_version>', but the footer reads 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>'.
findings.evidence: This follows the recorded orchestrator decision and T0-05's smoke assertion, which make web-smoke passes. It is a literal-reading difference only and was rebutted in earlier rounds.

resolution.reason: The footer wording follows the ralph orchestrator decision recorded in the story notes on 2026-11-14T21:24:28Z: keep T0-05's 'Bundle version: <bundle_version>' (shellText in apps/web/lib/shell.ts, asserted by make web-smoke and not owned by this story) and append ' · Schema <schema_version>'. That is how AC2's 'Bundle <bundle_version>' is read. The finding itself says it matches that decision and that make web-smoke passes; nothing to change.

findings.claim: The gzip -9 measurement of the initial JavaScript (author's figure: 177,190 B, +3,216 B over the 173,974 B baseline) was not reproduced.
findings.evidence: The command needs a loop or pipe, which the review permissions forbid. The build shows / as static, and site-header.tsx is the only 'use client' file in layout.tsx or the components I read.

resolution.reason: This is not a defect; the reviewer could not run the measurement. Reproduced at f9264cf after make web-build: the unique <script src> files in apps/web/.next/server/app/index.html, each run through gzip -9 -c | wc -c, give 6 scripts and 177,190 B in total. That matches the figure in the notes: 3,216 B over the T0 baseline of 173,974 B and within the PRD 8.10 budget of 250 kB. Command: grep -o '<script src="[^"]*"' .next/server/app/index.html | sed 's/<script src="\/_next\///;s/"$//' | sort -u | while read -r f; do gzip -9 -c ".next/$f" | wc -c; done | awk '{n++; t+=$1} END {print n, t}'.
